headline: Unreleased GTA VI Leads The Game Awards With 8 Nominations

image.licence: Official publisher media screenshot (Rockstar Games), credited
image.author: Rockstar Games
image.subject: In-game GTA VI screenshot 'Vice_City_15': Vice City skyline over a sunny marina with yachts and a jetty, a plane overhead; no watermark, no overlay lettering; a few tiny faceless NPC figures on the jetty sit under the headline block at card size

framing.why_focal: keeps the tallest tower centred and the logo in clear sky

image.not_used_before: Earlier idly GTA covers: Vice_City_01/10/22/27, Leonida_Keys_01, launch-gallery night skyline

fact_sources.fact: GTA VI has 8 nominations at The Game Awards 2026, the most; the 8 include Best Performance (Manni L. Perez as Lucia)
GTA VI's 8 categories: Game of the Year, Game Direction, Narrative, Art Direction, Score and Music, Audio Design, Action/Adventure, Performance
Six Game of the Year nominees: 007 First Light, Control Resonant, GTA VI, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo's Switch 2 remake)
Nominees revealed Tue 17 Nov around noon ET (10:30 PM IST)
Fan voting on thegameawards.com open until 9 Dec, 6 PM PT = 7:30 AM IST Thu 10 Dec
Show Thu 10 Dec, 4:30 PM PT (7:30 PM ET) = 6 AM IST Fri 11 Dec, Peacock Theater, Los Angeles, free stream
GTA VI unlocks at midnight local time on 19 Nov (12 AM IST in India) on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S

tag_evidence: Rockstar Games' own GTA VI site (https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/media/screenshots, the cover's source page) links to instagram.com/rockstargames (2 links in the page HTML). Owner of the cover image; a company, not a person.
